title: Moving two disks with auxiliary rod B
summary: Park the small disk on rod B, move the large disk to rod C, and place the small disk onto the large disk in three moves total.
context: The three rods from left to right are A, B, and C, and the goal is to move the two disks on A to C. Only one top disk may be moved at a time, and a larger disk cannot rest on a smaller disk; disk lists below are written from bottom to top on each rod.
Green denotes the large disk and blue denotes the small disk.
description: The four frames show the initial state followed by the states after each of the three single-disk moves: because step numbering in the player includes the initial frame, Steps 2, 3, and 4 complete moves 1, 2, and 3, respectively. Below the last three frames, completed move instructions are listed with the current move highlighted in light gray.

frames.title: Two disks stacked on rod A
frames.explanation: Initially A = [large disk, small disk], B = [], and C = [], with no move made yet. Because the blue small disk rests above the green large disk, the small disk must move to auxiliary rod B before the large disk can be freed.
frames.key_state: No move yet; A holds the large disk then the small disk from bottom to top, and B and C are empty.
frames.announcement: Show the initial state with the large and small disks stacked on rod A.

frames.title: Move the small disk from rod A to rod B first
frames.explanation: Move 1: move the blue small disk from A onto empty rod B, exposing the green large disk at the top of A. Now A = [large disk], B = [small disk], and C = [].
frames.key_state: Move 1 complete; A holds the large disk, B holds the small disk, and C is empty.
frames.announcement: Move 1: move the small disk from rod A to auxiliary rod B.

frames.title: Next move the large disk from rod A to rod C
frames.explanation: Move 2: with the green large disk on A unobstructed and rod C empty, move the large disk from A to C. Now A = [], B = [small disk], and C = [large disk], with the small disk still waiting on B.
frames.key_state: Move 2 complete; A is empty, B holds the small disk, and C holds the large disk.
frames.announcement: Move 2: move the large disk from rod A to destination rod C.

frames.title: Finally move the small disk from rod B to rod C
frames.explanation: Move 3: place the blue small disk from B onto the green large disk on C, keeping the smaller disk on top. Now A = [], B = [], and C = [large disk, small disk], completing the two-disk transfer.
frames.key_state: Move 3 complete; A and B are empty, and C holds the large disk then the small disk from bottom to top.
frames.announcement: Move 3: move the small disk from rod B onto the large disk on rod C, completing the transfer.
